cloud.name: cloud_dispatch
cloud.description:
Dispatch a versioned cloud job (CloudJobRequestV1 envelope; HTTP and MCP admit the identical schema).
autonomy="pipeline" requires kind + input. Available kinds and the input fields each one accepts:
- image-generation.prompt = Required description, 1–4000 characters; OpenAI gpt-image-2.5-flare, medium, one 1024×1024 PNG; actual text/image tokens billed, US$0.30 hold; delivery failure may still incur cost
- research.question = the question to research (required)
- research.search = search backend: "tavily" or "brave" use the platform web-search vendor; anything else falls back to the model's native web search
- code-review.diff = unified diff to review (takes precedence over `code`)
- code-review.code = source to review when no diff is given
- docs.code = source to document
- docs.type = document type, e.g. "readme" (default) or "api"
- office-report.topic = what the document should cover (alias: `task`); 1–4000 characters; fixed gpt-6.1-sol + Hosted Shell template
- office-report.task = alias of `topic`
- office-report.format = "docx" | "pptx" | "xlsx"; any other value falls back to "docx"
- office-report.data = optional complete JSON source data; unsupported template capacity fails without truncation
- html-generate.prompt = page requirements (required string; trimmed length 1–4000 UTF-16 code units, at most 12000 UTF-8 bytes); fixed gpt-6.1-sol + Hosted Shell template
- data-analysis.csv = CSV text to analyse (alias: `data`)
- data-analysis.data = alias of `csv`
- data-analysis.question = what to find out (alias: `task`); defaults to a general summary
- data-analysis.task = alias of `question`
- bugfix.files = map of path to file content the fix applies to
- bugfix.error = the failure or requirement to fix (alias: `task`)
- bugfix.task = alias of `error`
- bugfix.testCmd = shell command run in the sandbox after the patch is applied
- migration.files = map of path to file content to migrate
- migration.goal = the migration or refactor goal (alias: `task`)
- migration.task = alias of `goal`
Any other kind is refused before dispatch with code "unknown_pipeline_kind"; input fields not listed for the chosen kind are ignored.
autonomy="bounded-agent" requires objective + capabilities, a free-form string array in which {code_exec, file_mutation} route the job to the sandboxed tier.
Envelopes mixing or missing the fields of the chosen autonomy are rejected with code "envelope_invalid".

cloud.name: cloud_status
cloud.description: Get a cloud job's public status (tier-neutral). Returns {status, progress, counters?, result?}.

cloud.name: cloud_await
cloud.description: Poll a cloud job until terminal or timeout_sec (bounded ≤25s; call again for long jobs). Returns latest public status.

cloud.name: cloud_artifacts
cloud.description: List a cloud job's artifact descriptors (stable id, mime, size, sha256, provenance, contentRef). Content bytes are NEVER inlined; download via the authenticated content endpoint (contentRef.url resolved against the cloud API origin).

cloud.name: cloud_cancel
cloud.description: Cancel a cloud job. Returns {schema_version, job_id, status, accepted}: accepted:true means the job entered (or already was in) cancelling/cancelled; a terminal job answers accepted:false with its real terminal status (results are preserved). Status stays 'cancelling' until the stop protocol gathers positive evidence that execution halted.

cloud.name: cloud_web_search
cloud.description: Web search via the platform host-tool endpoint (Tavily/Brave keys stay in gateway; billed per call to the calling tenant). Returns {query, provider, results[]} on success (each hit: title/url/snippet?) or an error object with stable code on failure — never a free-form results string.

cloud.name: cloud_web_fetch
cloud.description: Fetch one public web page or JSON API over HTTP(S) via the platform host-tool endpoint and return its text (HTML tags stripped, truncated; billed per call to the calling tenant). Use it to read a specific URL you already know — use cloud_web_search first when you need to find one. Returns {url, status, content_type, content} where `status` is the target site's own HTTP status (a 404 is an answer, not an error), or an error object with a stable code (blocked_host, invalid_url, upstream_timeout, upstream_unreachable, redirect_invalid, too_many_redirects, response_too_large). Private, internal and platform-owned hosts are refused.

cloud.name: cloud_vision
cloud.description: Describe an image via the platform vision endpoint (billed per call to the calling tenant). Models: "qwen" (default): $0.002 per call, retries once on "gemini" at its own price when it fails; "gemini": $0.01 per call. Upstream faults (timeout/5xx/429/empty) always retry on the fallback model; a content-grounds refusal retries only when fallback_on_refusal is true (default), else answers content_refused. Returns {text, model, fallback_used, usage?} on success — model is the row that actually answered — or an error object with a stable code (unsupported_model | image_invalid | image_mime_mismatch | image_too_large | content_refused | content_blocked | provider_*) on failure. The image is sent to the model vendor via OpenRouter and is not stored by the platform.

image.description: The picture's bytes encoded as text (RFC 4648 §4 alphabet, padded; no data: URL prefix). Decoded size must not exceed 262144 bytes.

mime.description: Declared image type; must match the picture's file signature.

question.description: Optional question about the image (≤2000 chars). Omitted ⇒ the server's fixed template: what the image conveys, supporting details, then key text verbatim.

model.description: Which vision model answers. Closed set; default "qwen".

fallback_on_refusal.description: When the chosen model refuses the image on content grounds, retry once on its fallback model (default true). Upstream faults always retry on the fallback regardless.

cloud.name: cloud_decide
cloud.description: Answer many yes/no, pick-one or rating questions about one piece of text in a single call via the platform decide endpoint (billed per call to the calling tenant). Models: "jev" (default): $0.001 per call, up to 49152 bytes of state plus questions and 64 questions. Use it for batch judgments over text you already have (which search results matter, which log lines are real errors, which files relate to a change); do not use it to generate text, do arithmetic or compare dates. Answers are calibrated probabilities, not facts: noul returns {noul: probability of yes}; choice returns {choice, probabilities, confidence}; score returns {score, legend, probabilities, confidence}. Text only: embedded images or encoded binary are refused with non_text_input before any charge. Returns {model, answers, usage?} on success or an error object with a stable code (request_invalid | unsupported_model | non_text_input | input_too_large | provider_*) on failure. The text is sent to the model vendor (TypeSafe) through Cloudflare Workers AI and is not stored by the platform.

state.description: The text to judge: a plain string, or a JSON object/array of text (records, chat logs, lists). Text only — no `data:` URIs and no long runs of encoded binary; those are refused before any charge.

questions.description: Questions keyed by an id you choose; each answer comes back under the same id. type is "noul" (yes/no), "choice" (pick one of criteria) or "score" (rate on ordered criteria levels).

instructions.description: The yes/no question to evaluate against the state.

criteria.description: Optional clarification of what yes and no mean.

instructions.description: What to decide; the answer picks exactly one of the criteria keys.

criteria.description: Options: a map of option key to its description (null when no detail is needed); 1..255 options.

instructions.description: What to rate; the answer is a probability-weighted position on the levels.

criteria.description: Ordered level descriptions, lowest first; 2..10 levels.

model.description: Which decision model answers. Closed set; default "jev".

cloud.name: cloud_account_status
cloud.description: Free, read-only account check (never charged). Returns your membership allowance windows, wallet balance and available amount, and whether wallet overflow (pay from wallet after the allowance runs out) is on. Pass task (one of: image-generation, research, code-review, docs, office-report, html-generate, data-analysis, bugfix, migration, bounded-agent:openai_agents, bounded-agent:claude_code) to also get, for that task's FIRST billed step only: the amount it would reserve, whether it would be admitted right now (with the same refusal code cloud_dispatch would return), and a price estimate — or an explicit "cannot estimate" when the step is billed on actual usage. It does not promise the whole task is affordable. bounded-agent:claude_code has no reservable first step (its first model call is sized inside the sandbox), so only the account-level admission is reported. format (docx | xlsx | pptx) refines office-report.

word.name: read_docx
word.description: Read paragraphs and tables from a Word document

path.description: Absolute path inside the granted workspace

word.name: write_docx
word.description: Create, replace, or append to a Word document: title, body paragraphs, multi-level headings, tables, page size/margins (A4 default) and fonts (East Asian font set by default). Unknown fields are refused, never silently dropped.

path.description: Absolute path inside the granted workspace

title.description: Document title (Title style), written before the blocks

paragraphs.description: Document body in order. A bare string is a body paragraph; use heading blocks for section titles (e.g. 一、总体情况) instead of body text.

rows.description: Rectangular grid of cell strings; row 0 is the header when header=true

page.description: Page geometry. New documents default to A4 portrait with 25.4 mm margins; when appending, page is only changed if this field is given (then unspecified margins reset to 25.4 mm).

font.description: Document-default fonts. New documents always get an East Asian font (宋体 unless eastAsia is given); when appending, fonts only change if this field is given.

eastAsia.description: CJK font family, e.g. 宋体 / 黑体 / 微软雅黑

latin.description: Latin font family, e.g. Times New Roman

excel.name: read_xlsx
excel.description: Read cell values from every worksheet in an Excel workbook

path.description: Absolute path inside the granted workspace

excel.name: write_xlsx
excel.description: Create a workbook or update addressed cells in an existing workbook

path.description: Absolute path inside the granted workspace

path.description: Absolute path inside the granted workspace

powerpoint.name: write_pptx

path.description: Absolute path inside the granted workspace

path.description: Absolute path inside the granted workspace
